analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong first half for FY27 with significant growth in pre-sales, revenues, and profitability. Management highlighted robust demand in Mumbai's luxury housing market, three new project additions during the quarter, and an expanded ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprising 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores. The company maintained a net cash position and reiterated confidence in meeting its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores and INR2,000 crores alongside strong profit margins. Furthermore, management outlined plans for four new project launches in the second half of FY27. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported strong financial performance for H1 FY27, with pre-sales growing 176% YoY to INR 879 Crs.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: EBITDA and PAT margins for FY27 are expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs for FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins of 35% to 40% and PAT margins of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with luxury segment leading and prime residential prices rising.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is largely driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that luxury buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle.
demand_outlook.quote: Our buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial properties are witnessing good momentum and offer sustainable margins.
demand_outlook.quote: So, yes, there is a good moment for commercial properties, and we have very balanced portfolio of commercial.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial and fintech sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces in the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand Indicator: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand in Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

capex_expansion.claim: Three new projects were added during the quarter: Lotus Impressa, Lotus Stellar, and Lotus Supremus.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City project is a 5.5-acre land parcel expected to feature mixed-use development.
capex_expansion.quote: Sure. It's a 5.5-acre land parcel, which is sitting right on the river Sabarmati. It's in GIFT area.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding into the GIFT City area with a new mixed-use project.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion in GIFT City Area with Flagship Ultra Luxury Project

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured three new projects in Q2 FY27, adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched two new projects in Q1 FY27 with a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q2 rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores with EBITDA expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 PAT stood at INR134 crores at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management states the company is net debt-free and incurs very limited marketing expenses.
margins_costs.quote: As far as margins are concerned, as I have mentioned earlier, we are a net debt-free company. So, we don't have to pay or we don't have any burden of interest. Second, till today, we have not done any marketing expenses, very limited awareness campaign we did.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 39.9% for Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a consistent PAT margin of 25%-30%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin (%) ~ 25%-30% on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a PAT margin of 34.5% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Marketing expenses are expected to be approximately 1% of pre-sales.
margins_costs.quote: Of course, our expense would be I would say about 1% approximately, but that also will be able to recover because what happens that during this advertising, there would be many clients we will be getting directly, where we will not be spending any money on brokerage.

orders_capacity.claim: Ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 stood at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Delighted to share that we recorded pre-sales for the quarter at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a total saleable area of approximately 3.5 million sq. ft. in its current project portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, our estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: Net proceeds from the fresh issue of the IPO were approximately INR732 crores, with INR305 crores deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun. INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, which management notes is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to various risks including economic performance and industry competition.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that luxury buyers are not driven by loan rates, but acknowledged broader market uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of delivering the FY27 guideline for pre-sales, revenue, and PAT growth.
management_commitments.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to receive the OC for the Amara and Athena projects within this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Hi. So in the Amara, we have completed the RCC, and we hope that this quarter we will get OC, otherwise, this financial year definitely, as predicted, will get the OC.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: The GIFT City project is expected to be completed by FY31.
The company intends to dilute promoter stake to 75% or below within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have got total three years. One year has passed, so we have still two years to go. And within that time, I think we'll be able to dilute that.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to collect around INR1,000 crores in cash this year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year we are intend to collect around INR1,000 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
